Compared with the original guide

The maintained mod includes integrated Heater optimization, expanded header editing, resource distributors, save tools and AutoSing. Read the current feature list for their behavior.

Old corruption loadouts, the separate mod Ambrosia quickbar and incomplete legacy calculation tools are not advertised as current features.
